lead.event: ULTJ plans a rights issue to fund its acquisition of Frisian Flag Indonesia
lead.headline: ULTJ plans Rp16.94 trillion rights issue to fund Frisian Flag Indonesia acquisition
lead.blurb: Ultra Jaya will seek shareholder approval at an EGM on 6 November to issue 7.88 billion shares at Rp2,150 each, with a rights ratio of 15,200:11,517. About 86.01% of proceeds would fund its planned acquisition of 100% of Frisian Flag Indonesia, valued at Rp14.57 trillion, and the remainder would go to working capital. FrieslandCampina International Holding, Frisian Flag Indonesia’s parent, would become ULTJ’s controlling shareholder under the proposed rights transfers. Shareholders who do not exercise their rights could face dilution of up to 43.11%.

other.event: SMAR announces an interim dividend of Rp490 per share
other.headline: SMAR announces interim dividend of Rp490 per share
other.blurb: Sinar Mas Agro plans to distribute Rp1.4 trillion for fiscal 2026, backed by Rp4.06 trillion in net profit attributable to owners as of 30 September and a 34.65% payout ratio. The cum date is 12 November, with payment scheduled for 26 November.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Pefindo downgrades WIKA's bond rating after a missed coupon payment
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Pefindo cuts WIKA bond rating to idD after delayed coupon payment
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The downgrade takes WIKA's Continuation III Phase I bond from idCCC to idD after its coupon due on 3 November was delayed. Pefindo kept the corporate rating at idSD and may review ratings if overdue principal, coupon and profit-sharing obligations are settled.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Fitch downgrades Pos Indonesia's sukuk after a missed payment
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Fitch downgrades Pos Indonesia's Rp1 trillion sukuk to default
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Pos Indonesia failed to pay ijarah returns due 8 October, and its 14-working-day grace period expired. The Series A, B and C sukuk were its last outstanding issuance, leaving it in default on all its issuances. It canceled its 17 November bondholder and obligor meeting pending audited financial statements.

earnings_guidance.event: ANTM reports nine-month 2026 earnings growth and its shares rebound
earnings_guidance.headline: ANTM reports 47.9% nine-month profit growth as shares rebound
earnings_guidance.blurb: Aneka Tambang posted net profit of Rp8.84 trillion for January–September, while third-quarter revenue and profit fell 22.8% and 17.9% quarter on quarter. Shares rose 8.33% to Rp2,600 on 4 November after hitting a year-to-date low of Rp2,400 on 3 November. BRI Danareksa, Maybank and UBS maintained Buy ratings.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Mayapada reports nine-month 2026 net profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: MAYA reports 107% nine-month net profit growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Mayapada’s capital adequacy ratio strengthened to 11.09% from 10.09%. Gross non-performing loans fell to 3.36% at 30 September from 4.02% in June.

earnings_guidance.event: KIJA reports nine-month 2026 results and outlines its 2027 outlook
earnings_guidance.headline: KIJA reports 9M26 revenue up 16% to Rp4.25 trillion and discusses 2027 outlook
earnings_guidance.blurb: Jababeka's net profit fell 38% to Rp391.7 billion from Rp634.6 billion a year earlier, reflecting one-off refinancing costs in Q2. The company refinanced its US dollar-denominated senior notes into a rupiah-denominated bank facility and expects the move to deliver long-term financial benefits.

earnings_guidance.headline: HAJJ reports third-quarter revenue up 43.1% to Rp294.07 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Arsy Buana Travelindo's nine-month revenue fell to Rp657.67 billion from Rp727.25 billion a year earlier, while operating cash flow turned positive at Rp77.96 billion from a negative Rp60.53 billion. Hotels contributed 91.61% of nine-month revenue.
